findings.title: A store miss is reported as a store read failure
findings.retires: The ambiguous merge-row note that collapses “the store answered with no statement” into “the store could not be read.”
findings.severity: Blocking when attestation_command exits 1 (the established “store read successfully but holds no statement” state); harmless only while every nonzero exit denotes an unreadable store.

findings.title: Ledger row construction adds a second attestation-store read to doctor proof six
findings.specimen: attavo/ledger.py:251 via item_acts_and_interventions, called from attavo/doctor.py:970
findings.retires: The regression whereby proof six reads the same merge statement again while recomputing acts and interventions, despite its contract saying “No new read of the store.”
findings.severity: Blocking when attestation_command is stateful, costly, one-shot, or returns a different result on its second invocation; harmless only when repeated reads are guaranteed identical and side-effect-free.
